trans-unit.source: This sample database will go over using 4D Netkit to connect to and interact with - Google's Gmail API - Microsoft's Graph API This demo will allow you to - send and receive emails - create email labels/folders Click on one of the tabs above to get started
trans-unit.target: This sample database will go over using 4D Netkit to connect to and interact with - Google's Gmail API - Microsoft's Graph API This demo will allow you to - send and receive emails - create email labels/folders Click on one of the tabs above to get started

trans-unit.source: First, click on the Sign in button below to obtain the access token from Google. Because of Google's protection against MITM phishing, they require the authentication to be based in the browser. Click on Advanced > Go to Netkit example (unsafe). Then fill out the rest of the boxes to create and send an email
